claims.statement: The company expects to continue growing the waterproofing category at more than double digits.
claims.quote: Overall, we are looking at growing more than double digits in that category.

facts.statement: Interiors performed much better during the quarter due to an extended monsoon affecting exterior painting.
facts.quote: The interiors would have done much better this quarter, given the fact that there was extended monsoon. And please remember, in the monsoon, the exterior painting suffers.

facts.statement: The economy segment remains the largest segment in the market compared to mid-level and luxury categories.
facts.quote: the economy segment will still be the largest segment in terms of the market.
